info.name: Traveler's Guide to Elysia
info.description: Artworks for the Artist class in Aurora Builder.
info.author: Michael

description.p: Sequence: Black → Red (Bludgeoning → Fire)
When you complete this Artwork, you draw a blazing stroke across the battlefield.
Choose a direction originating from the Canvas. A line 40 feet long and 10 feet wide extends from the Canvas and lasts for 3 rounds.

ul.li: The area becomes burning ground.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 2d6 fire damage.
The area counts as difficult terrain.
The fire does not ignite unattended objects.

sheet.description: Sequence: Black → Red. Create a 40-foot by 10-foot line for 3 rounds. Creatures entering or starting their turn there take 2d6 fire damage, and the area is difficult terrain.

description.p: Sequence: Blue → Black (Cold → Bludgeoning)
When you complete this Artwork, the space around the Canvas locks into rigid stillness.
Creatures of your choice in a 15-foot radius centered on the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature’s speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature’s speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

description.p: In addition, the area in the radius becomes difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

sheet.description: Sequence: Blue → Black. Creatures of your choice in a 15-foot radius make a Constitution save. On a failure, speed becomes 0; on a success, speed is halved until the end of the creature’s next turn. The area is difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

description.p: Sequence: White → Black (Radiant → Bludgeoning)
When you complete this Artwork, a descending arc of judgment strikes downward.
Choose a 30-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line extending from the Canvas. Creatures in the line must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 3d6 radiant damage and is knocked prone.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and is not knocked prone.

description.p: A creature knocked prone by this effect has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

sheet.description: Sequence: White → Black. Creatures in a 30-foot by 10-foot line make a Constitution save or take 3d6 radiant damage and fall prone. On a success, they take half damage and do not fall prone.

description.p: Sequence: Green → Black (Poison → Bludgeoning)
When you complete this Artwork, corrosive force eats away at form and balance.
Creatures of your choice in a 10-foot radius centered on the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 2d8 poison damage and has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws until the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half damage with no additional effect.

description.p: The area remains slick and unstable for 3 rounds, counting as difficult terrain.

sheet.description: Sequence: Green → Black. Creatures of your choice in a 10-foot radius make a Constitution save or take 2d8 poison damage and have disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws until the end of their next turn. The area is difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

description.p: Sequence: Black → Red → Black (Bludgeoning → Fire → Bludgeoning)
When you complete this Artwork, the Canvas detonates outward with crushing force.
Each creature of your choice within a 20-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 4d6 fire damage, is knocked prone, and is restrained by warped terrain until the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and is not restrained.

description.p: The area becomes difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

sheet.description: Sequence: Black → Red → Black. Creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Dexterity save or take 4d6 fire damage, fall prone, and are restrained until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take half damage and are not restrained. The area is difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

description.p: Sequence: Black → Purple → Black (Bludgeoning → Necrotic → Bludgeoning)
When you complete this Artwork, a lingering sense of inevitability settles over the battlefield.
Creatures of your choice in a 30-foot radius centered on the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 3d8 necrotic damage and is Weakened for 3 rounds.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and is Weakened until the end of its next turn.

description.p: A creature reduced to 0 hit points while Weakened by this Artwork cannot be revived until the end of your next turn.

sheet.description: Sequence: Black → Purple → Black. Creatures of your choice in a 30-foot radius make a Constitution save or take 3d8 necrotic damage and become Weakened. On a success, they take half damage and are Weakened until the end of their next turn.

description.p: Sequence: Yellow → Blue → Orange (Lightning → Cold → Acid)
When you complete this Artwork, a violent fracture tears outward from the Canvas.
Choose a direction originating from the Canvas. A line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide erupts along the ground.
Creatures in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 5d6 lightning damage, is knocked prone, and has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and is not knocked prone.

description.p: The line becomes unstable terrain for 3 rounds. It counts as difficult terrain, and a creature that moves more than 10 feet within it on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

sheet.description: Sequence: Yellow → Blue → Orange. Creatures in a 60-foot by 10-foot line make a Dexterity save or take 5d6 lightning damage, fall prone, and have speed reduced to 0 until the start of their next turn. The line becomes unstable difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

description.p: Sequence: White → Purple → White (Radiant → Necrotic → Radiant)
When you complete this Artwork, a sphere of oppressive stillness forms around the Canvas.
A 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the Canvas lasts for 3 rounds.
While inside the sphere:

ul.li: Creatures cannot regain hit points.
Creatures have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration.
A creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 3d8 radiant damage.

description.p: The sphere is heavily obscured to creatures outside of it.

sheet.description: Sequence: White → Purple → White. Create a 20-foot-radius sphere for 3 rounds. Creatures inside cannot regain hit points, have disadvantage on concentration saves, and take 3d8 radiant damage when entering for the first time on a turn or starting their turn there.

description.p: Sequence: Green → Orange → Green (Poison → Acid → Poison)
When you complete this Artwork, corrosive growth spreads outward from the Canvas.
A 30-foot-radius area centered on the Canvas becomes warped terrain for 3 rounds.

ul.li: The area is difficult terrain.
A creature that starts its turn in the area must make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 acid damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its turn.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and suffers no additional effect.

description.p: Unattended nonmagical objects in the area begin to corrode but are not destroyed instantly.

sheet.description: Sequence: Green → Orange → Green. Create a 30-foot-radius area for 3 rounds. The area is difficult terrain. Creatures that start their turn there make a Constitution save or take 4d6 acid damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their turn.

description.p: Sequence: Yellow → Purple → Blue → White (Lightning → Necrotic → Cold → Radiant)
When you complete this Artwork, gravity bends violently toward the Canvas.
A 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the Canvas becomes a collapsing field for 3 rounds.
When the field forms, each creature of your choice inside it must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 6d8 force damage and is pulled to the nearest unoccupied space within 10 feet of the Canvas.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and is not moved.

description.p: While the field persists:

ul.li: The area is difficult terrain.
A creature that ends its turn more than 10 feet from the Canvas is pulled 10 feet toward it.
Creatures have disadvantage on Strength saving throws while inside the field.

description.p: The field collapses harmlessly at the end of the duration.

sheet.description: Sequence: Yellow → Purple → Blue → White. Create a 30-foot-radius collapsing field for 3 rounds. Creatures inside make a Constitution save or take 6d8 force damage and are pulled toward the Canvas. The area is difficult terrain and continues pulling creatures inward.

description.p: Sequence: Green → Orange → Purple → White (Poison → Acid → Necrotic → Radiant)
When you complete this Artwork, reality within the Canvas’ reach destabilizes.
Choose a 40-foot-radius area centered on the Canvas. For 3 rounds, the area is warped.
When the effect begins, creatures of your choice in the area must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 5d10 necrotic damage and gains one level of exhaustion.
On a success, the creature takes half damage and does not gain exhaustion.

description.p: While the area persists:

ul.li: Creatures cannot regain hit points.
A creature that drops to 0 hit points within the area cannot regain hit points until it leaves the area.

sheet.description: Sequence: Green → Orange → Purple → White. Create a 40-foot-radius warped area for 3 rounds. Creatures make a Constitution save or take 5d10 necrotic damage and gain exhaustion. Creatures in the area cannot regain hit points.

description.p: Sequence: Red → Yellow → Blue → Green (Fire → Lightning → Cold → Poison)
When you complete this Artwork, the Canvas detonates into a storm of unstable elements.
Each creature of your choice within a 60-foot radius of the Canvas must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 8d6 damage, divided evenly among fire, lightning, cold, and poison.
On a success, the creature takes half damage.

description.p: In addition, the ground within 30 feet of the Canvas becomes unstable for 3 rounds:

ul.li: The area is difficult terrain.
A creature that moves more than half its speed on its turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

sheet.description: Sequence: Red → Yellow → Blue → Green. Creatures of your choice within 60 feet make a Dexterity save or take 8d6 split elemental damage. The ground within 30 feet becomes unstable difficult terrain for 3 rounds.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → Yellow (Fire → Lightning)
Completion: A violent line of searing light erupts from the Canvas in a direction of your choice, forming a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line.
Creatures in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 fire damage and 2d6 lightning damage.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

description.p: This effect does not create burning ground.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → Yellow. Creatures in a 30-foot by 5-foot line make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 fire and 2d6 lightning damage. On a success, they take half damage.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → Green (Fire → Poison)
Completion: Creatures of your choice within 15 feet of the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 3d8 fire damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effect.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → Green. Creatures of your choice within 15 feet make a Constitution save or take 3d8 fire damage and are Poisoned until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take half damage.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → Yellow → Red (Fire → Lightning → Fire)
Completion: The Canvas erupts in a roaring detonation.
Creatures of your choice within a 20-foot radius of the Canvas must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 6d6 fire damage and 4d6 lightning damage.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

description.p: The area becomes burning ground for 3 rounds. The burning ground deals 2d6 fire damage per trigger.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → Yellow → Red. Creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Dexterity save or take 6d6 fire and 4d6 lightning damage. On a success, they take half damage. The area becomes burning ground for 3 rounds.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → Purple → Red (Fire → Necrotic → Fire)
Completion: A wave of delirious heat floods outward.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 5d8 necrotic damage and 3d8 fire damage and has disadvantage on its next saving throw before the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

description.p: This effect does not create burning ground.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → Purple → Red. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a Constitution save or take 5d8 necrotic and 3d8 fire damage and have disadvantage on their next saving throw. On a success, they take half damage.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → White → Yellow → Red (Fire → Radiant → Lightning → Fire)
Completion: A blinding corona of destructive brilliance expands outward.
Creatures of your choice within 60 feet of the Canvas must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 10d6 total damage, divided as you choose between fire, radiant, and lightning.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

description.p: The area within 30 feet of the Canvas becomes burning ground for 3 rounds, dealing 3d6 fire damage per trigger.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → White → Yellow → Red. Creatures of your choice within 60 feet make a Dexterity save or take 10d6 damage divided between fire, radiant, and lightning. On a success, they take half damage. The area within 30 feet becomes burning ground for 3 rounds.

description.p: Prerequisite: Romanticism Movement
Sequence: Red → Green → Yellow → Red (Fire → Poison → Lightning → Fire)
Completion: Flames twist into binding coils of violent color.
Creatures of your choice within a 40-foot radius of the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.

ul.li: On a failure, a creature takes 8d8 fire damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is not Restrained.

description.p: This effect does not create burning ground.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Romanticism. Sequence: Red → Green → Yellow → Red. Creatures of your choice within 40 feet make a Constitution save or take 8d8 fire damage and are Restrained until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take half damage and are not Restrained.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → Yellow (Psychic → Lightning)
Completion: Creatures of your choice within 15 feet of the Canvas must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature:

ul.li: Has disadvantage on its next saving throw before the end of its next turn.
Has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

description.p: On a success, the creature’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → Yellow. Creatures of your choice within 15 feet make a Wisdom save. On a failure, they have disadvantage on their next saving throw and have speed reduced by 10 feet. On a success, their speed is reduced by 10 feet.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → Blue (Psychic → Cold)
Completion: The area within 20 feet of the Canvas becomes warped.
Creatures of your choice in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, the creature’s speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
On a success, the creature’s speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → Blue. Creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Dexterity save or have speed reduced. On a failure, speed becomes 0 until the start of the creature’s next turn. On a success, speed is halved.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → Yellow → Orange (Psychic → Lightning → Acid)
Completion: Choose up to three creatures within 30 feet of the Canvas.
Each must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save:

ul.li: The creature must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move up to half its speed in a direction of your choice.
The creature has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

description.p: On a success:

ul.li: The creature does not move but has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → Yellow → Orange. Up to three creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save. On a failure, they move as directed and have disadvantage on their next attack roll. On a success, they do not move but still have disadvantage on their next attack roll.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → White → Green (Psychic → Radiant → Poison)
Completion: Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the Canvas must make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature is:

ul.li: Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
Blinded until the start of its next turn.

description.p: On a success, the creature is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → White → Green. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a Constitution save. On a failure, they are Poisoned until the end of their next turn and Blinded until the start of their next turn. On a success, they are Poisoned until the start of their next turn.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → Yellow → Blue → Orange (Psychic → Lightning → Cold → Acid)
Completion: Creatures of your choice within 40 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature:

ul.li: Is Restrained until the end of its next turn.
Has disadvantage on all saving throws until the end of its next turn.

description.p: On a success, the creature is Restrained until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → Yellow → Blue → Orange. Creatures of your choice within 40 feet make a Wisdom save. On a failure, they are Restrained and have disadvantage on all saving throws until the end of their next turn. On a success, they are Restrained until the start of their next turn.

description.p: Prerequisite: Fauvism Movement
Sequence: Pink → White → Yellow → Pink (Psychic → Radiant → Lightning → Psychic)
Completion: Choose one creature within 60 feet.
The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is:

ul.li: Stunned until the end of its next turn.
Has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

description.p: On a success, the creature is Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Fauvism. Sequence: Pink → White → Yellow → Pink. One creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn and has disadvantage on its next saving throw. On a success, it is Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Blue (Radiant → Cold)
Completion: Allies of your choice within 15 feet of the Canvas gain advantage on the next saving throw they make before the end of their next turn.
In addition, their movement speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Blue. Allies of your choice within 15 feet gain advantage on their next saving throw and +10 feet movement speed until the end of their next turn.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Teal (Radiant → Thunder)
Completion: Choose up to two allies within 20 feet of the Canvas.
The next time each chosen creature is hit by an attack before the end of your next turn, reduce the damage taken by 2d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Teal. Choose up to two allies within 20 feet. The next time each is hit by an attack before the end of your next turn, reduce the damage by 2d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Blue → Green (Radiant → Cold → Poison)
Completion: Allies of your choice within 30 feet of the Canvas gain:

ul.li: Advantage on their next attack roll.
Resistance to the next instance of damage they take before the end of their next turn.

description.p: Each benefit ends after it is used.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Blue → Green. Allies of your choice within 30 feet gain advantage on their next attack roll and resistance to the next damage they take before the end of their next turn. Each benefit ends after it is used.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Pink → Yellow (Radiant → Psychic → Lightning)
Completion: Choose up to three allies within 30 feet of the Canvas.
Until the end of their next turn:

ul.li: They add 1d6 to their next attack roll or saving throw.
They can move through difficult terrain without expending extra movement.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Pink → Yellow. Choose up to three allies within 30 feet. Until the end of their next turn, they add 1d6 to their next attack roll or saving throw and ignore extra movement from difficult terrain.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Blue → Teal → White (Radiant → Cold → Thunder → Radiant)
Completion: Allies of your choice within 40 feet of the Canvas immediately regain hit points equal to 3d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
In addition, they have advantage on saving throws until the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Blue → Teal → White. Allies of your choice within 40 feet immediately regain 3d8 + your Wisdom modifier hit points and have advantage on saving throws until the start of your next turn.

description.p: Prerequisite: Impressionism Movement
Sequence: White → Pink → Blue → White (Radiant → Psychic → Cold → Radiant)
Completion: Choose up to four allies within 40 feet of the Canvas.
Until the end of their next turn:

ul.li: The first attack they make that hits deals an additional 2d8 radiant damage.
The first time they fail a saving throw, they may reroll it.

description.p: Each benefit can trigger only once per creature.

sheet.description: Prerequisite: Impressionism. Sequence: White → Pink → Blue → White. Choose up to four allies within 40 feet. Until the end of their next turn, the first hit they land deals 2d8 extra radiant damage and the first saving throw they fail can be rerolled.
